_comment: FX-ACT-02: create/update/delete activity builders — golden IssueActivity rows per type. Transcribed from bgtasks/issue_activities_task.py:557-1501. Common frame: requested_data/current_instance arrive as JSON STRINGS (json.loads at builder entry; None stays None); issue_id/project_id/workspace_id/actor_id/epoch passthrough unless noted. ACTIVITY_MAPPER has 27 entries (see mapper_type_keys); there is NO cycle update, NO module update, NO attachment update, NO intake update/delete.

create.new_value: <current_instance.asset> — NOTE: read from CURRENT instance, not requested
create.note: requested_data parsed but UNUSED; signature order is (..., actor_id, workspace_id, ...) swapped vs siblings — port call order per builder

delete.note: no identifiers, no values at all; current_instance/requested_data ignored (parsed or not: requested NOT parsed here)
current_instance IGNORED (not even parsed); link carried on issue_comment_id only

update.new_identifier: <current.id> — NOTE: current id reused for new_identifier, not requested

create.issue_updated_touch: Issue.objects.filter(pk).first(); issue.updated_at=now(); save(update_fields=['updated_at']) per record, guarded by if issue
create.new_value: <cycle.name> — DEREFERENCED, crashes AttributeError if cycle row missing (no guard)
create.per_created: created_cycle_issues is a JSON STRING inside current_instance (double-encoded): json.loads(current['created_cycle_issues']); per record cycle=Cycle.objects.filter(pk=record.fields.cycle).first(), issue row by record.fields.issue
create.per_updated: updated_cycle_issues is a LIST inside current_instance (NOT a string); per record old/new Cycle lookups (.first(), None-safe via ternary), issue row touched, comment=f'updated cycle from {old or ''} to {new or ''}' (literal newline + 16 spaces before 'to' — port byte for byte)

delete.comment: removed this issue from <cycle.name or cycle_name fallback> (f-string)
delete.cycle_lookup: Cycle.objects.filter(pk=cycle_id).first(); old_value uses cycle.name if found else requested cycle_name
delete.per_issue: one row per id in requested.issues; each issue row touched first

delete.note: NO issue_id on the row (project/workspace only); inputs ignored

update.rule: requested.is_draft is False -> 'created the issue' (verb updated, NO field); anything else (True, None, missing) -> 'updated the draft issue' with field 'draft'

create.assignees_rule: track_assignees runs ONLY if requested.assignee_ids is not None (key presence with None value skips; 12 other trackers do NOT run on create)
create.requested_json_loads: requested_data = json.loads(requested_data) — CRASHES on None (None.get); create callers always pass a JSON string

issue.update: for key in requested_data (JSON-parsed): func = MAPPER.get(key); unknown keys SKIPPED silently (no error); current_instance json.loads parsed (None ok — trackers .get on None would crash only if a mapped key is present)

delete.current_json_loads: current_instance = json.loads(current_instance) — CRASHES on None (no guard); requested_data NOT parsed

create.issue_touch: Issue.objects.filter(pk=issue_id).first() touched (NOT the module's issue — the activity's own issue_id)
create.module_lookup: Module.objects.filter(pk=requested.module_id).first(); new_value '' when missing (None-safe), new_identifier = requested.module_id RAW (may be None)

delete.comment: removed this issue from <module_name> (f-string, None-safe only by interpolation)

create.issue_id: <comment.issue_id> — the COMMENT's issue, NOT the passed issue_id arg
create.lookup: CommentReaction.objects.filter(reaction, project_id, actor_id).values_list('id', 'comment__id').first() UNPACKED directly — None (no match) raises TypeError (no guard); comment then fetched with IssueComment.objects.get (raises DoesNotExist, no guard)
create.row_gate: comment AND reaction id AND comment id all not None

delete.issue_resolved: IssueComment.objects.filter(pk=current.comment_id, project_id).values_list('issue_id', flat=True).first(); row ONLY if found

create.lookup: IssueReaction.objects.filter(reaction, project_id, actor_id).values_list('id', flat=True).first(); row ONLY if found (None-safe)

create.gate: current_instance is None AND requested.issues non-null
create.old_identifier_asymmetry: forward row old_identifier = related_issue ID; mirror row old_identifier = issue_id (the SIBLING's id, not its own)
create.per_related_issue: TWO rows: forward on issue_id (Issue.objects.get(pk=related_issue), raises if missing) + mirror on related_issue (Issue.objects.get(pk=issue_id))

comment_pair: deleted <relation_type> relation (both rows use the REQUESTED type in text, even the mirror)
delete.field_mirror_rule: blocking<->blocked_by swapped ONLY for that pair; every other type (incl. start_/finish_/implemented_) mirrored VERBATIM
delete.per_call: TWO rows, no loop (single related_issue key)

create.verb: updated — NOTE: created maps to verb 'updated', not 'created'
